purpose: Introduce a vivid likeness or an almost complete resemblance.
keywords: まるで + noun + のよう / みたい; まるで + negative
This cloud looks just like a huge ship.
She smiled as if nothing had happened.
I heard the explanation, but I do not understand it at all.
formation: まるで + noun + のよう / みたい; まるで + negative
restrictions: With a negative predicate it can mean completely not, rather than a comparison.
mistake: The comparison is figurative; it need not be literally true.
